items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Franie Trombert and Jimmy Dorsey and those people had things like the Bouncing Ball.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, he could always improvise, but at the time he executed an awful lot. He played an awful lot of fast things; as I mentioned earlier, Franie Trombert and Jimmy Dorsey and those people had things like the Bouncing Ball. Well, that was like running a lot of scales, and that's what he used to do. You know, he used to run all over the horn a lot, but I think when he went to the tenor -- and this is just my assumption; I don't have any way, we never discussed it, I imagine it maybe was a larger instrument and…

But Lester played the way he was; that's the way I think. He was a very softspoken man, and he was an extreme introvert. You know, he was extremely introverted. He was not out at all. Very few people knew him. I'm positive of that.
